find:
let level = first, area = grow(level);
      if (area === null) continue;
replace: let level = first, area = grow(level) ?? Infinity;
note: W4-05 / DESIGN-SPEC 6.1 and 14.3: H and L only at closed centres. The mutant treats a region that runs off the grid, into missing data or into a deeper node as closed, so every local minimum and maximum is marked whether or not an isobar closes round it (an open trough, a node on a regional grid's edge, a dip beside missing data). The unit test's open-trough grids (minimum on the edge row; a true interior minimum whose isobar runs off the west edge) and NaN-hole grids must see an L that is not there.
